It offers a stark contrast to Angkor's stone temples by including a paddle through a flooded mangrove forest.
> * This experience is available year-round, requires advance booking, and includes luxury SUV transfers and private wooden boat tours to observe floating schools and police stations. It is best paired with an afternoon after a morning of temple viewing.
> * AGS ensures priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury private transfers for this ecological and eye-opening tour, which focuses on communities adapted to the Tonle Sap's five-fold volume increase during monsoon season.

## The AGS Executive Summary
Cruise the vast inland sea of Southeast Asia. Observe the incredible, stilted, and floating communities of the Tonle Sap lake, witnessing a lifestyle entirely dictated by the water.

## The Operator & Origin Story
The Tonle Sap is a unique ecological marvel; the river connecting it to the Mekong reverses volume dramatically during the monsoon, increasing the lake's size five-fold. The communities living here have adapted dynamically, living in floating houses or structures raised on 10-meter stilts.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
You bypass the heavily commercialized Chong Khneas village, driving further to the more authentic Kompong Khleang or Mechrey. Boarding a private wooden boat, you cruise out into the expanse. 

You will observe floating schools, floating police stations, and the incredible ingenuity of the fishermen. The tour often includes a paddle through a flooded mangrove forest, providing a stark contrast to the stone temples of Angkor.

## Exploring Tonle Sap’s Flooded Forest & Stilted Villages From Siem Reap
Located 35 to 50 minutes south of Siem Reap depending on seasonal lake levels, **Tonle Sap Floating Village Exploration** takes guests to authentic lacustrine communities such as **Kompong Khleang** or **Mechrey**, deliberately bypassing the commercialized tourist boat traps at Chong Khneas. Because the entire 4-to-5-hour excursion takes place aboard a shaded private wooden motor launch and hand-paddled sampan through submerged mangrove canopies, physical strain is minimal—making it an ideal afternoon counterpart to a dawn 18-hole tee time at [Angkor Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/angkor-golf-resort/) or [Phokeethra Country Club](/courses/cambodia/phokeethra/), or a tranquil morning excursion before an afternoon spa session at [Zannier Hotels Phum Baitang](/accommodations/cambodia/zannier-phum-baitang/) or [Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-grand-dangkor/).

## Seasonal Hydrology & Private Boat Charter Standards
* **High-Water vs. Dry-Season Dynamics:** Between August and January, monsoon inflow from the Mekong causes the Tonle Sap to expand fivefold, submerging tree trunks and bringing water right up to the verandas of 10-meter-high stilted houses in Kompong Khleang—coinciding with the start of Cambodia’s peak November–February golf window. From February through May, receding waters reveal towering timber stilts and fertile lakebed agriculture.
* **Private Cushioned Launch & Sunset Aperitifs:** Asia Golf Specialists charters private shallow-draft wooden vessels outfitted with cushioned seating, life vests, and chilled coolers stocked with cold towels, Angkor beer, and French rosé as the sun drops across Southeast Asia’s largest freshwater lake.
* **Zero-Walking Recovery Between Championship Rounds:** For golfers playing three consecutive days across [Angkor Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/angkor-golf-resort/), [Phokeethra Country Club](/courses/cambodia/phokeethra/), and [Siem Reap Booyoung Country Club](/courses/cambodia/siem-reap-booyoung/), spending an afternoon reclining aboard a private river launch across the Tonle Sap biosphere offers complete lower-body rest before returning to [Amansara](/accommodations/cambodia/amansara/) or [Zannier Hotels Phum Baitang](/accommodations/cambodia/zannier-phum-baitang/).

faqs.q: Which Tonle Sap village does Asia Golf Specialists use for private boat tours from Siem Reap?
faqs.a: We bypass the crowded Chong Khneas pier in favor of authentic Kompong Khleang or Mechrey (40–50 minutes from Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor and Zannier Phum Baitang), where towering 10-meter stilted houses and flooded mangrove forests remain unspoiled.

faqs.q: When is the best season to combine a Tonle Sap boat tour with golf in Siem Reap?
faqs.a: November through February is the sweet spot: water levels in the flooded forest and stilted villages remain high from the monsoon reverse-flow, while daytime skies are dry and cool for morning golf at Angkor Golf Resort and Phokeethra Country Club.

faqs.q: Can we do the Tonle Sap Floating Village tour in the afternoon after a morning round of golf?
faqs.a: Yes. Departing your Siem Reap hotel at 2:00 PM after a morning round at Angkor Golf Resort puts you on the lake for cooler late-afternoon breezes and golden-hour views across the water before returning by 6:30 PM.
